title: s2_4_install_plan_core_v1
description: Unsigned canonical aggregate core for one S2.4 APPLY transaction (§5.1). It is the exact object signed by the aggregate install profile: its canonical digest yields plan_core_digest, plan_id = 's2-4-' + hex(plan_core_digest) and idempotency_key = plan_id. The core therefore deliberately excludes plan_id, idempotency_key, any authorization object/signature and any self_digest (those are derived/attached later and live only in the plan artifact / authorization_set). It binds the ordered set of the five APPLY component rows (each by exact v2 effect class plus its component-intent digest), the terminal prepare-effect-receipt digest, the attested pre-mutation topology digest, the signed HBA-delta digest, the expected pre-state digest and the source-head/target-host. Contract only: no runtime/production PASS is asserted here.
